angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,652,694 km at 55.66 pc = 0.4 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.9656 +/- 0.0212 mas (same row, RUWE 0.86): 55.66 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2.376 (2.328 to 2.423) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,652,694 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.327 (1.287 to 1.367) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5806 +/- 5.2 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5950535424666050304: teff_gspphot 5805.5874 K (16th-84th percentiles 5799.3726-5809.8247), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5950535424666050304: teff_gspphot 5805.5874 K (16th-84th percentiles 5799.3726-5809.8247), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/inquill.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 3.809, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 156411 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 IV/V, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 156411 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.12 dex, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 156411 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.731, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 156411 (pscomppars): age 4.28 Gyr, from Jofré et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015A&A...574A..50J/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 156411 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.3 km/s, from Naef et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...523A..15N/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
